requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: Select 15 credits (at least 6 credits at the 400-level) in NUTR. No more than 3 credits of NUTR 495B and 3 credits of NUTR 294, NUTR 494 or NUTR 494H can count toward the additional courses credit requirement. Independent study credits (NUTR 296 and NUTR 496) do not count toward the Nutrition Studies minor.
